{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
top_species = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Extract the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = top_species.index[0]

# Print results for evidence
print(f'Mean flipper length by species:\n{top_species}')
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}')"}
